title: Which level fixes qualitative character is an empirical question

statements.text: Whenever processing has two stages, the stages can mismatch, on any hierarchical theory. Higher-order theorists differ on whether the higher-order level alone or both levels jointly fix qualitative character, and experiments can test whether it is predicted by prefrontal activity, early sensory activity, or both.

sources.quote: This is an empirical question that can be addressed by future experiments that directly test whether the qualitative character of conscious perception can be predicted entirely from prefrontal activity, early sensory activity alone, or both.
